title: AlphaSpec Gate Result
description: What a runtime returns after judging a submitted artifact or score series. Produced by the runtime, never by the submitter.

subject.description: Identifier of the judged artifact or score series.

computedBy.description: PLATFORM: performance figures were recomputed by the runtime. SELF_REPORTED: they came from the submitter. Public rankings must accept PLATFORM only.

outOfSampleFrom.description: Chosen by the runtime and not visible at submission time.

checks.description: One entry per criterion, so a failure can be diffed and explained, not just reported.

metric.description: What `actual` and `threshold` measure, so a reader never infers it from the code. One check can switch measures (out-of-sample is judged on excess return when the runtime has a benchmark index, on Sharpe when it has not). Values used by the reference runtime: totalReturn, maxDrawdown, sharpe, excessReturnVsIndex, deflatedSharpeProbability, structural. Returns and drawdowns are fractions (0.05 = 5%).

hint.description: What to change to pass, in plain language.

tradeSettings.description: The trade settings the evaluation actually ran with, in AlphaSpec field names, and which of them the runtime filled in because the document left them out.

sizing.description: Absent when the runtime's default sizing cannot be expressed as an AlphaSpec sizing block; the defaults entry for /sizing then says in words how positions were sized.

field.description: JSON pointer into the artifact, e.g. /sizing or /execution/fillTiming.

value.description: The value the runtime used, or a sentence describing it.
